verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own marketing says it can 'automate invoice payments and approval flows'. It also offers smart invoice scanning for bill intake, invoice audit trails, and bill-pay invoice review with vendor management. The approval workflow itself appears only as a one-line claim, with no detail on routing rules, approver tiers or how approval gates payment release. missing for 10: documented approval routing configuration (approvers, thresholds, multi-step chains), explicit bill-upload workflow docs, evidence that payment is blocked until approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors

citations.quote: Automate invoice payments and approval flows
automate the process through smart invoice scanning technology
Add additional security with employee permissions and invoice audit trails.
